# DatePicker
A field trigger that opens a calendar panel to pick a date, or (mode="range") a date range. Visually a bordered field like Input/Select, but opens a grid, not a list.

USE WHEN
• A single date must be picked from a full calendar view (birthdate, due date, booking date)
• A date range must be picked (mode="range": check-in/check-out, reporting windows)
• The exact day matters more than quick relative entry (unlike a text "in 3 days" field)
• Long-range navigation matters more than month-by-month browsing (birthdates) — pair with `<DatePickerContent captionLayout="dropdown" />` for Month/Year selects instead of arrow nav

DON'T USE WHEN
• Only a month or year is needed — use Select instead
• The date is naturally typed (ISO strings, freeform search) — use Input instead
• A time component is also needed — pair with a separate time control (not built in v1)

DO
• Always show a placeholder that names the expected value ("Pick a date" / "Pick a range")
• Close the calendar and return focus to the trigger once the selection is complete
• Mark today's cell distinctly from the selected cell(s)

DON'T
• Reuse Select's popover for the calendar — dates need a grid, not a list
• Allow keyboard focus to land on disabled or (in range mode) adjacent-month blank cells

PROPERTIES
• mode: "single" (default) | "range" — range makes value/defaultValue a [start, end] tuple (mirrors Slider's range pair, DEC-023)
• Trigger State: default | hover | focus | open | disabled | invalid
• Date cell State: default | hover | selected | today | outside-month | disabled | range-start | range-middle | range-end
• Placeholder: boolean — whether the trigger shows placeholder text or a formatted value
• DatePickerContent captionLayout: "label" (default) | "dropdown" — single mode only, range mode ignores it and stays "label"
• DatePickerContent yearRange: [number, number] — the dropdown caption's Year <select> range, defaults to 100 years back to 10 forward

TOKENS
• Trigger: background, border / primary (focus, open) / danger (invalid), radius/lg, spacing/3 padding
• Panel: surface-overlay, border, shadow/md, radius/lg
• Date cell: primary + primary-foreground (selected, range-start, range-end), primary-subtle (range-middle), border-strong (today ring), foreground-subtle (outside-month), foreground-disabled (disabled), radius/lg

CODE
import { DatePicker, DatePickerTrigger, DatePickerContent } from '@atlas/ui-web';

<DatePicker value={date} onValueChange={setDate}>
  <DatePickerTrigger placeholder="Pick a date" />
  <DatePickerContent />
</DatePicker>

<DatePicker mode="range" value={range} onValueChange={setRange}>
  <DatePickerTrigger placeholder="Pick a range" />
  <DatePickerContent />
</DatePicker>

<DatePicker value={dob} onValueChange={setDob}>
  <DatePickerTrigger placeholder="Select a date" />
  <DatePickerContent captionLayout="dropdown" />
</DatePicker>

## API
```tsx
import { DatePicker, DatePickerTrigger, DatePickerContent } from "@atlas/ui-web/compositions/DatePicker/DatePicker"
```

**DatePicker**
- ref: not forwarded — `ref` does not type-check; reach the element by `id`
- no own props

**DatePickerTrigger**
- ref: forwarded
- `invalid?: boolean`
- `placeholder?: string`
- `formatDate?: (date: Date) => string`
- `formatRange?: (range: DatePickerRange) => string`
- `icon?: boolean | React.ReactNode`

**DatePickerContent**
- ref: forwarded
- `side?: DatePickerSide`
- `captionLayout?: "label" | "dropdown"`
- `yearRange?: [number, number]`
